g.text: idx_products_name_search (name) USING gin(to_tsvector('english', name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
idx_skus_stock (stock_quantity) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND active = true
idx_prices_current (sku_id, is_current) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_current = true
idx_prices_version (sku_id, version) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
FK: sku_id -> skus(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK: user_id -> users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
One active cart per user (enforced by unique index)
FK: cart_id -> carts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
UNIQUE: (cart_id, sku_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
GIN index on name for PostgreSQL
